concerns.text: The try-catch logic for extracting and parsing the 'userId' from HTTP headers/parameters is duplicated across DocumentController and DocumentSearchController. It is recommended to extract this logic into a shared utility class or request helper to improve maintainability and avoid code duplication.

The test class 'IntegrationsContractValidationTest' is annotated with '@SpringBootTest' and '@ActiveProfiles("test")', which spins up the entire Spring ApplicationContext. Since the test only reads and validates the OpenAPI contract file ('docs/contracts/Integrations.openapi.yaml'), it can be implemented as a lightweight unit test without booting up the Spring Boot context, significantly reducing test suite execution time.
